prompt: Create one square premium painterly naturalistic Chinese mythology illustration, no writing. Xixi 鰼鰼 from Shan Hai Jing is a fabulous fish whose FORM RESEMBLES A MAGPIE, has EXACTLY TEN WINGS, and SCALES AT THE ENDS OF ITS FEATHERS. Show one magpie-shaped creature poised just over a clear mountain river. One magpie-like head with beak, slender magpie-like body and long tail feathers; do not invent a separate fish head or fish tail. The central body carries FIVE PAIRS OF DISTINCT FEATHERED WINGS, exactly FIVE wings extending to the viewer's left and FIVE to right, ten TOTAL; each wing separately attached and displayed in a staggered broad fan with visible air gaps so all ten are easily countable. Wing feathers end in subtle small overlapping silvery scale plates. Clear front three-quarter composition, wings fill square but uncropped. Black-white plumage is editorial natural magpie interpretation. Water, stones and distant mountain pines with soft natural light; restrained watchful presence. No fire effect, glowing aura, neon, energy ribbons, extra heads, horns, hands or legs.

visual_review.notes: Native inspected and counted five feather wings on each side, ten total, magpie-like head/body, individual silvery scale tips, river habitat; no aura/fire effect.
